title: Neovim Built-ins
description: Defaults that ship with modern Neovim: commenting, repeating :s, quickfix and diagnostic jumps.

levels.title: Comment out
levels.description: Comment out the three print calls. No plugin needed since Neovim 0.10.
levels.hint: gc is the comment operator: gcc comments a line, gc2j comments this line and the two below.

levels.title: Again, everywhere
levels.description: You already fixed 'colour' on the first line with :s. Do the same on every line.
levels.hint: g& repeats the last :s on every line, with the same pattern and flags.

levels.title: Quickfix hopping
levels.description: The quickfix list holds every oops() in the project and you're on the first. Turn each one into ok().
levels.hint: ]q jumps to the next quickfix entry (and [q to the previous). Fix one, then ]q and . for the rest.

levels.title: Fix the error
levels.description: There's an error somewhere in this file. Jump straight to it and fix it.
levels.hint: ]d jumps to the next diagnostic. From there, swap the two letters that are the wrong way round.

commands: lua vim.diagnostic.set(vim.api.nvim_create_namespace('vimdojo.level'), 0, { { lnum = 9, col = 2, message = 'unknown keyword: retrun', severity = vim.diagnostic.severity.ERROR } })
